seo.title: Thank you: project request received
seo.description: Your project request has reached Calwebtech. Here is what happens next and when you will hear from us.

title: Thanks. Your project request is with us.
intro: Your details and your notes about the project have gone straight to the people who scope and price our work. A confirmation email is on its way to the address you gave.

steps.title: We review your request
steps.body: We look at your current site and what you told us, so the first conversation starts from your situation rather than a script.

steps.title: We email you within one business day
steps.body: A person replies to book a thirty minute call at a time that suits you.

steps.title: You get a written proposal
steps.body: Within two business days of the call: scope, timeline, a fixed price and exclusions, in writing, with no obligation.

secondary.heading: While you wait
secondary.body: See how a project runs week by week, including what we will need from your team and when.

image.alt: A project team planning a website with sticky notes on a whiteboard
